subtitle: Updates mapped to your Power BI to Genie migration, the store-ops apps on Lakebase, and your AI governance program

items.title: Genie One MCP server
items.what: Genie is exposed as a governed conversational tool over Model Context Protocol for any MCP-capable agent.
items.why: Store-ops assistants can answer from curated sales tables instead of generic scans.

items.title: Metric view window measures
items.what: Rolling, cumulative, and semiadditive aggregations defined once in Unity Catalog metric views.
items.why: Recreates the Power BI time-intelligence measures (rolling, YTD) for the Genie migration.

items.title: Dataset materialization for dashboards
items.what: Pre-compute and store dashboard dataset results on a schedule for instant interactivity.
items.why: Import-mode speed for the regional sales reports moving off Power BI.

items.title: Governed tag propagation via lineage
items.what: Unity Catalog uses lineage to apply governed tags to derived tables automatically.
items.why: PII classification follows loyalty data downstream without manual tagging.

items.title: Metastore-level ABAC policies
items.what: A single attribute-based policy applies across every catalog in the metastore.
items.why: One company-wide masking rule instead of per-catalog policies for each banner.

items.title: Lakebase autoscaling
items.what: Lakebase Postgres scales compute up and down with load, including scale to zero.
items.why: Store-ops apps absorb weekend peaks without paying for idle capacity midweek.

items.title: Agent Bricks Supervisor Agent
items.what: Coordinate Genie spaces, knowledge assistants, and tools behind one governed agent.
items.why: One store-manager assistant that routes between sales, labor, and policy questions.

items.title: Partner guardrails via service policies
items.what: External service policies send requests and responses to your guardrail vendor and block denied calls.
items.why: Central PII and prompt-injection enforcement for every agent and app.
